7912.title: Hidden action padding on cross-project child rows
7912.rootCauseOneLine: A cross-project label selects permanent quick-action padding even while the action overlay is invisible.
7912.proposedFix: Remove the cross-project-label term from permanent action-space reservation; reuse the existing hover inset and preserve parent disclosure behavior.
7912.caveats: Rendered component/CSS reproduction with synthetic SDK boundaries and explicit desktop CSS media selection; no macOS full-app claim. Regression code is embedded in the report, not CI-wired.
